knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.falsifier: A separate matched-capacity context-conditioned versus context-independent/shuffled transport study would be required; these probes neither reproduce nor refute CRAFT.

assessments.rationale: Read archived v1 section 5.3 lines 683-719 (text SHA256 7714c79aba968b84d631bb677ca87a16614add7785fff830fd99b93e33b39727). Tiny single-path component ablations and mixed fusion AUC/loss do not establish a missing local readout bottleneck.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No FM Highway, bus fusion, auxiliary labels or optimizer change. Inherited shallow forward remains identical.
assessments.falsifier: A separately authorized capacity-matched direct-readout contrast is needed. Backward VJPs cannot test the reported forward highway mechanism.

assessments.nearest_work_difference: Measurement extension only; no new training rule.
assessments.falsifier: Failed bridges or degenerate/null common-state differences do not support the local probe hypothesis.

assessments.rationale: Complete original record consulted; retain chronological/action half penalties, mean negatives, tiny adjacency recovery and source/optimizer confounds. Later rank-half evidence narrows its temporal-locality account.
